headline: The board has walked out three times in a row — slot a raises the stall to Jon
lede: Session 90 targeted #1463, hit slot b's live lock, and then derived — live, from the READMEs and the issue board again — that nothing is left for a builder lane to self-commission: no steer/next/queue, both feedback items already QA's, all flagship honest-gaps closed. That is three consecutive sessions without merged game code, so #1456 now carries the playbook's STALLED prefix: the factory is healthy but idle, and only Jon's answer (or a new game-queue label) restarts the line.

notes.text: STALLED: applied to #1456 per playbook (3 consecutive sessions, no merged game code: 88, 89, 90). Evidence posted in-issue. Deadline 2026-11-04T17:45Z, default: hold idle.
TARGET #1463 refused by the live-lock (#878): slot b claimed at 21:53Z and is demonstrably mid-build. Slot a yielded as designed — the liveness namespace worked.

Board exhaustion derived live, not from memory: idle.mjs sees 0 open gaps across SSX, Emberwood, COMET DRIFT HD, Myst (CLOSED markers verified against the READMEs); #1468 was claimed by QA studio one minute before the scan; two QA MASTER sessions live.

main is green at f7e6402 (main-ok: nightly has not run yet). To commission work right now: label an item game-queue/next/steer — e.g. the next Myst Age under #838 — and a lane takes it at the very next kick.
